jobs.title: Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. This role brings together commercial strategy, business intelligence, demand planning, and bid management in one function. Working as a strategic partner and deputy to the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, the Bid Director owns the full pursuit lifecycle, from market strategy and pre-tender capture through bid submission and handover to delivery. We're looking for a strategist who is equally strong commercially, technically, and financially, and who leads people and cross-functional teams with confidence.

Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.

Responsibilities:

Commercial Strategy, Business Intelligence, and Demand Planning

Shape the commercial strategy with the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, including target markets, regions of focus, and growth priorities.
Lead the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager across planning, pricing policy, business intelligence, and demand planning.
Build business and bid intelligence (market, customer, competitor, and procurement insight) that drives strategy, pipeline, and pursuit decisions.
Own demand planning and pipeline forecasting, aligning bid capacity and resources with expected opportunities and revenue targets.

Pre-Tender, Capture, and Bid/No-Bid

Own a gated process that all pre-tender pursuits follow, aligned with commercial strategy and target regions.
Deliver capture plans for strategic and specific pursuits, shaping opportunities well before tender release.
Own bid/no-bid recommendations, presenting a clear view of strategic fit, path to win, risk, and financial return to senior leadership.

Bid Strategy and Execution

Frame each bid to win: set win themes, value proposition, competitive discriminators, and pricing position at kickoff.
Shape solutions and commercial offers with Operations, Technical, Finance, and Legal so they are competitive, deliverable, and profitable.
Build and challenge bid financial models, pricing, and business cases, ensuring every bid meets agreed margin thresholds.
Embed disciplined bid planning, with clear milestones, review gates, owners, and deadlines.

Leadership and Partnership

Lead and develop a team of Bid Managers, Bid Specialists, Bid Coordinators, and the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager as one high-performing function.
Direct cross-functional bid teams with authority and hold contributors accountable to deadlines.
Make timely, confident decisions under ambiguity and balance risk against win potential.
Connect sales, bids, contracts, and delivery, so what we sell is what we can deliver profitably.

Experience:

12+ years in bid, capture, commercial, or business development roles, including 5+ years leading teams at a senior manager, director level, or equivalent.
Commercially and sales-savvy: a track record of winning large, complex tenders and a strong understanding of sales cycles, customer relationships, and market positioning.
Strategic: able to frame opportunities, set bid strategy, and make clear recommendations to executives.
Technically proficient: able to understand and shape technical and operational solutions, engage credibly with SMEs, and turn requirements into compelling, deliverable offers. Comfortable working with data, BI, and planning tools.
Financially strong: skilled in financial modeling, pricing, P&L, cash flow, and margin management, and able to defend bid financials with Finance and executive leadership.
A confident leader: builds high-performing teams and influences senior stakeholders across functions.
Professional fluency in French and English, written and spoken (proficiency in a third language is a bonus). English is required to work with Lyft teams, customers, and partners across North America and internationally.
Preferred: APMP or Shipley experience, multi-region bidding, and a background spanning bid and delivery.

Benefits:

Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the Montreal office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the Montreal area is CAD $182,000 - CAD $227,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: VP, Advanced Client Analytics
jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Marketing

Pay Details

$185,000 - $245,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

Vice President, Advanced Client Analytics

Department Overview

TD has a bold ambition to become the undisputed leader in Client Experience. The Client Experience team serves as the enterprise steward of client experience across TD, accountable for shaping, measuring, and improving end-to-end client experiences partnering with businesses, channels, products, and journeys. Reporting to the SVP, Client Experience, the team provides an integrated enterprise view of client experience performance benchmarks, client needs, and associated business impact, bringing together client feedback, complaints, advanced client experience analytics, research, and market benchmarks to identify opportunities for improvement. The team establishes and governs enterprise client experience standards, drives consistency across all client touchpoints, and partners with business and functional leaders to resolve top client pain points, elevate critical moments that matter, and strengthen client relationships. Through thought leadership, influence, measurement, and adoption of client standards across the bank, the team champions a client-centric culture, fosters accountability, and helps ensure TD delivers simple, personalized, and differentiated experiences that create value for clients.

Job Summary

The Vice President, Advanced Client Analytics will be accountable to build, manage and operationalize an AI and Agent enabled Client insights factory to connect client feedback, operational signals, and financial outcomes to prioritize the right actions to improve Client Experience. Client Insights Factory will integrate client feedback, operational and behavioral indicators, Open Banking information and financial data, using advanced analytics and AI to identify drivers of client advocacy, predict client friction, link client experience to financial outcomes and prioritize action.

The role is accountable for building the vision, executing on building an industry leading client intelligence function to inform all client level decisions, as the single source of truth for TD clients.

Accountabilities

Integrate Voice of Customer (VOC) signals, including surveys, complaints, escalations, social, and frontline feedback.
Conduct analytics to understand client experience drivers, segmentation, root causes, and financial impact.
Develop predictive insights related to attrition, complaints, service failure, and promoter growth.
Build and maintain the enterprise VOC platform, issue taxonomy, and root-cause hierarchy.
Real time monitoring of key client experiences and irritants through AI / Agentic solutions
Enable Natural Language Processing capabilities to mine Client experience data to democratize advanced client insights at TD.
Build CX economics, linking key experiences to revenue, attrition, cost-to-serve, and lifetime value.
Lead value realization activities, including ROI tracking, prioritization, and challenge of assumptions.
Monitor key irritants and must-win client moments through dynamic dashboards
Establish data-driven linkage between CX priorities and impact on the Bank's strategic pillars.

Portfolio Scope

The Role Is Accountable For

VOC, Operational and Financial information for a single source of client truth
Customer analytics and predictive modelling
CX economics and experience to financial linkage
Value realization office and prioritization
Command centre monitoring and irritant tracking

Key Interactions

CX Measurement & Research
Data / AI / Analytics teams
Technology partners
Finance
Lines of Business / Channels
Complaint and frontline feedback sources

Success Measures

Success In This Role Is Demonstrated Through

An integrated view of client issues and drivers.
Predictive capability to identify issues early.
Clear linkage between CX and financial outcomes.
Data-driven prioritization of CX investments.
AI and Agentic enablement

Educational Requirement

Undergraduate degree required in a relevant discipline.
MBA considered an asset

TD Story

Founded in 1855, TD has grown from a single branch serving grain millers and merchants into one of the largest and most respected financial institutions in North America. As we continue to develop a more global, integrated approach to our businesses, it is important that every employee, regardless of location, is aware of TD's history and impressive growth story. Over 150 years of service. Read more about TD's rich history.

Our Strategy

There's never been a more exciting time for TD. We are a strong, competitive bank with clear advantages and we're leveraging our unique strengths to enhance the client experience, drive performance, and create long-term shareholder value.

With exceptional talent across our organization, and millions of loyal clients who depend on us for their financial success, we are poised to accelerate growth and deliver peer-leading performance.

Our Strategy Is Detailed Across Three Pillars

We're driving Deeper Relationships with our clients, to help them meet all of their financial needs, and accelerate growth across all our businesses.

We're building a Simpler & Faster Bank, stripping out complexity and harnessing the power of AI and digital capabilities to outpace the market and meet our clients' evolving needs.

We're bringing Disciplined Execution, sharpening our focus, driving outcomes, and holding ourselves and each other accountable to deliver.

The TD Way: Our Purpose, Promise & Culture

Our Purpose

Reimagine what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our purpose defines why we exist. It’s our bold ambition to shape the future of banking, not just adapt to it. We’re building a simpler, faster bank for our clients, our colleagues and our communities.

Our Promise

Remarkably human. Refreshingly simple.

Our promise is how we deliver on our purpose. It's what people feel when they interact with TD: how we show up, deliver value and bring our brand to life through every experience.

Being Remarkably Human means maintaining a personal connection and deepening trust in everything we do. It’s how we design experiences that feel genuinely helpful, compassionate and meaningful.

Being Refreshingly Simple means taking the complexity out of banking – speeding up decisions, simplifying processes and creating clarity for our clients and colleagues alike.

Our Culture

TD’s culture is a reflection of our shared beliefs, attitudes, and behaviours. When aligned with strategy, it’s a game-changing accelerator. To advance our strategic progress, we're focused on strengthening aspects of our culture – who we are and how we lead – that will help us succeed.

Together, we call this The TD Way. It’s how we activate the strengths and capabilities of our colleagues and leaders to realize the opportunities ahead, ensuring that our culture, strategy and brand are deeply connected and brought to life in every experience we create.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Language Requirement (Quebec Only)

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - Permanent - 19222
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Our internationally recognized, growing client in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) is seeking a forward-thinking Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This opportunity joins a progressive organization that offers professional growth and development while being a key player within the Senior Leadership team. The CFO will lead Finance functions and provide leadership to the Finance & Accounting team, creating a positive, optimal experience as growth continues both locally, nationally, and on the international stage.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Strategic Financial Leadership

Partner with the CEO to develop and execute the company's long-term growth strategy
Lead enterprise-wide financial planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and performance management
Provide strategic guidance on expansion initiatives, manufacturing investments, capacity planning, and operational efficiency
Support business development, commercial growth, and international expansion opportunities

Financial Planning and Analysis:

Develop and implement financial strategies, plans, and budgets aligned with the company's goals and objectives
Conduct financial analysis, forecasting, and modeling to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement
Monitor key financial metrics and provide regular reporting to senior management
Lead the annual budgeting process and long-term financial planning efforts
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement to drive profitability

Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Development

Develop and execute an acquisition strategy aligned with the company's growth objectives, evaluate strategic partnerships
Drive integration efforts to maximize operational efficiencies and financial returns
Manage capital allocation decisions, including capital expenditures, investments, and financing activities as needed
Lead equity raises, debt financings, and other capital markets transactions
Demonstrate strong understanding of IPO readiness and execution, including financial reporting, governance, internal controls, and investor communications
Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, lenders, and other external stakeholders- effectively communicate the company's growth story and value proposition
Serve as a key liaison with financial institutions, regulatory agencies, and external auditors
Communicate financial performance, forecasts, and strategic initiatives to the executive team and external stakeholders
Optimize the company's capital structure and liquidity position to support growth and operational needs
Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO and board on financial matters and strategic decisions

Manufacturing & Operational Finance

Provide financial leadership across manufacturing operations, supply chain management, procurement, inventory management, and distribution
Drive improvements in gross margin, operational efficiency, working capital, and cash flow performance
Establish financial metrics and reporting systems to support manufacturing and operational decision-making
Evaluate capital expenditure investments, facility expansions, automation initiatives, and production optimization programs
Support strategic sourcing and supply chain resilience initiatives

Regulatory, Compliance & Risk Management

Ensure compliance with all applicable financial, healthcare, and manufacturing regulations, implement effective internal controls and compliance programs to safeguard assets and mitigate risks
Oversee financial infrastructure, including SOX compliance and reporting processes
Maintain strong internal controls, governance practices, and enterprise risk management frameworks
Partner with internal and external auditors to maintain high compliance standards
Stay abreast of changes in financial regulations and industry trends to ensure compliance as well as assess and manage financial risks, including credit, market, and operational risks

Financial Operations

Oversee all aspects of financial operations, including accounting, budgeting, treasury, and tax compliance
Oversee Finance & Accounting team, providing leadership, direction, and fostering a collaborative culture and continuous improvement
Prepare accurate and timely financial statements and reports for management and external stakeholders
Ensure timely, accurate, and transparent financial reporting to management, investors, and external stakeholders
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies
Mentor and develop finance professionals, promoting skill development and career growth within the organization

About You

The successful candidate will have the following:

CPA Designation, Active in Good Standing
Proven experience in a senior financial leadership role, with 5+ years at an executive level
Strong understanding of financial principles, accounting standards and practices, IPOs, Mergers & Acquisitions, and regulatory requirements
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and make strategic recommendations
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders
Demonstrated leadership ability, with a track record of building high-performing teams and driving results
Strategic mindset, with the ability to think creatively and contribute to overall business strategy and growth initiatives

How To Apply

Please apply by clicking the “Apply Now” button below and follow the instructions to submit your résumé. You can also apply by submitting your résumé directly to sgomi@lrostaffing.com. If you are already registered with us, please contact your Senior Recruiter. Please quote job 19222
.

LRO Staffing values fairness, confidentiality, and human judgment in every stage of our hiring process. We do not use automated or AI-driven screening tools to assess applications. Each submission is reviewed by an experienced recruiter to ensure a thoughtful and equitable evaluation of every candidate.

Thank you for your interest in this role. One of our Recruiters will be in touch with you if your profile meets the requirements for the role and the expectations of our clients. Please note that all candidates must be permitted to work in Canada to be considered for this opportunity.
